description: A first order low pass and high pass filter fed from one input, normalised to a maximum gain of 0dB with no resonant peak.

params.text: Sets the corner frequency of the filter, 20Hz to 20480Hz, starting at 261.63Hz.
Attenuates the cutoff CV input, and inverts it when turned below zero.
Sets how much of the unfiltered input is mixed into the outputs, 0 to 100%, starting at nothing.
Sets how much of the filtered signal reaches the outputs, 0 to 100%, starting at 100%.
Scales the level leaving the outputs, 0 to 100%, starting at 30%.
Attenuates the drive CV input, and inverts it when turned below zero.

inputs.text: The audio to be filtered; sixteen channels are filtered separately.
Shifts the corner frequency by one octave per volt, scaled by its attenuverter.
Raises the output level the drive knob sets; 10V adds the whole of it with its attenuverter at maximum.

outputs.text: The low pass version of the input, clamped between -5V and 5V.
The high pass version of the input, clamped between -5V and 5V.

notes: the cutoff and drive CV inputs are each multiplied by the attenuverter beside them, and those start at zero, so a patched cable changes nothing until one is turned up.
menu: Structure — chooses the arithmetic the biquad is calculated with: Direct, Canonical, TransposeDirect or TransposeCanonical, the last of which stays steadiest under fast modulation.
